newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bankers Trust NZ to buy Doyle Paterson - sources.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust NZ to buy Doyle Paterson - sources.

text.p: Bankers Trust New Zealand Ltd will shortly announce the acquisition of Wellington brokers Doyle Paterson Brown, financial market sources said.
The sources, who declined to be identified, said the purchase price was unlikely to be revealed.
Bankers Trust NZ is a unit of Bankers Trust New York.
An announcement from Bankers Trust NZ is expected on Wednesday.
Further details are expected when BTNZ is due to make its announcement on Wednesday.
Financial market sources have speculated for some weeks as to whether another another New Zealand brokerage would be purchased by a major international bank.
Bankers Trust NZ, a successful niche player in the local market, has long wanted to play a greater role in New Zealand equities and is seeking to bolster its retail market presence.
Sources said Doyle Paterson Brown was well known as having a strong research team and good overseas connections, particularly with U.S. fund managers and institutions.
The acquisition of Doyle Paterson Brown would continue the trend of the last few years of major international groups buying New Zealand operations.
